title: Shared normalized ordinary pullback and strict finite Koszul tower data
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a scheme morphism $g:X\to Y$. Use the completed module categories $\mathcal M_W$, ordinary pullback $G_g$ with its fixed adjunction unit, and transposition at independent coefficient and scheme universes [def-a1-integral-completed-tower-pullback-universes]. Use the actual total tensor and sheafified summand generator [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], the ordered principal Koszul and restricted constant quotient towers $Q_{W,n}$ and $S_{W,n}$ and their augmentation [def-a1-principal-completed-koszul-towers], and the strict finite pullback tower $B_g^0$ [def-a1-integral-finite-pullback-tower]. The following notation is fixed, for all unbounded complexes $P$ and $n\in\mathbf N$ (positive exponent $n+1$). Let $G$ on complexes be the termwise lift of $G_g$, and let diagram pullback apply $G$ to every object and arrow. The pulled generator of $x\in M(V)$ is its image under the fixed adjunction unit at $V$. The total tensor generator of $x\in P^p(U)$ and $y\in Q^q(U)$, where $p+q=k$, is their sheafified pure tensor followed by the total-degree-$k$ summand inclusion. The quotient generator is the degree-zero single-complex inclusion of a section of $S_{W,n}$. The degree-zero and degree-minus-one Koszul basis maps are the standard cone target and shifted-source inclusions; write $e_i$ for either basis vector. Set $U_W(P)_n=P\otimes S_{W,n}$, $H_W(P)_n=P\otimes Q_{W,n}$, and $a_W(P)=1_P\otimes\epsilon_{W,n}$, retaining all actual transitions, and express $B_g^0$ also as a complex of strict module towers by transposition. A reduction comparison $r:U_W(P)\simeq(P\otimes_{R_W}S_{W,n})_n$ is normalized when it sends the total tensor generator $x\otimes z$ to the actual scalar-extension generator $z\otimes x$. A Koszul comparison $\theta:G H_Y(P)\simeq H_X(GP)$ is normalized when $(x\otimes e_i)\otimes b$ maps to $(x\otimes b)\otimes e'_i$ for both basis vectors in every total-degree summand, without a sign. A balanced comparison $\lambda:U_X(GP)\simeq B_g^0(P)$ is normalized when $(b\,\eta_g(x))\otimes1$ maps to $\pi_{X,n}(b)\,\eta_{g_n}(1\otimes x)$ in every degree and on every base-changed site object. These predicates retain the specified adjunction and quotient maps; they assert no comparison theorem, K-flatness, boundedness or invertibility of $c_g$. The prescribed quotient-unit normalization for the whole C comparison sends a pulled generator $b\otimes g^{-1}(x\otimes 1)$ to $\pi_n(b)\eta_{g_n}(1\otimes x)$. The published-comparison identification uses the normalized sectionwise universe-transport predicates of [def-a1-completed-pullback-universe-transport-data].
